name: Hacker News Search API (Algolia)
description: Public, keyless read-only search over the full Hacker News archive, powered by Algolia. Provides keyword search across stories and comments, with relevance ranking (/search) or reverse-chronological ordering (/search_by_date), plus time and type filtering. Complements the official Firebase Hacker News API, which offers item/list browsing but no keyword search.
